continuity: Lei Fei is one of China's concealed S-rank Hunters and led the Public Security Armed Forces Department stationed in Sichuan Province.
Lei Fei disappeared with the Hunters under his command when the first Monster Wave began one week earlier; his death remains unconfirmed because the Arch Lich blocked communications and surveillance.
Wei Fenghu is Lei Fei's maternal uncle and raised him as his own son.
Jin Taekyung promised Wei Fenghu that he would bring Lei Fei back if he encountered him, while warning that he could not guarantee Lei Fei's survival.
The temporary operations headquarters is located on Mount Qingcheng in Sichuan Province.
plot: Wei Fenghu transports Jin Taekyung and Team Leader Choi in a state-guest business jet escorted by five fighter aircraft because Sichuan Province is effectively at war due to magical communications interference and flying-monster attacks. During the flight, Wei explains that the disaster began in Gaoping District of Nanchong City and reveals that Lei Fei, a concealed Chinese S-rank Hunter and head of the Sichuan Public Security Armed Forces Department, disappeared with his Hunters when the first Monster Wave began. Wei, Lei Fei's maternal uncle and adoptive father, believes Lei Fei is alive and asks Jin to bring him back if they meet; Jin agrees without making a guarantee. The aircraft arrives at a temporary operations headquarters on Mount Qingcheng.
translation_decisions: Render 레이페이 as Lei Fei and 공안무력부 as Public Security Armed Forces Department.

Render 대교 as Senior Colonel and 동지 in military address as Comrade.
Render 견마지로 as utmost loyalty and 옥체 as august self while preserving Shao Shen's exaggerated deferential tone.
Preserve the 국밥부장 pun as Minister of gukbap.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung is Level 121, has the Undead Hunter Title, and keeps the strengthened Skeleton Warlord in his Inventory under the mocking name Bones.
The Arch Lich's three incomplete Liches were destroyed at Chengdu International Airport, and their testimony identified the Arch Lich as responsible for the undead army's actions.
Wei Fenghu is China's Minister of National Defense under the Central Military Commission, a four-star general, and the current Chairman's right-hand man.
Sichuan Province is in a wartime emergency involving magical communications interference, flying-monster attacks, and a Monster Wave that began in Gaoping District of Nanchong City.
China has deliberately concealed at least one of its S-rank Hunters, Lei Fei, who led the Public Security Armed Forces Department stationed in Sichuan Province.
Lei Fei disappeared with his department's Hunters when the first Monster Wave began, and neither his death nor his survival has been confirmed.
Wei Fenghu is Lei Fei's maternal uncle, raised him as his own son, believes he is alive, and asked Jin Taekyung to bring him back if found.
Jin Taekyung agreed to Wei Fenghu's request but did not guarantee that Lei Fei would be found alive.
The temporary operations headquarters is at Mount Qingcheng.
